d:
Six police personnel, including ASP Deepak Mishra and SDOP Chanchalesh Markam, have been suspended in connection with a viral video from a hotel in Seoni, Madhya Pradesh.
The video allegedly shows police officers threatening a young man and woman and talking about planting cannabis in the man's bag.
Hotel owner Sanjay Sanodia has also alleged that police personnel demanded around ₹50,000 every month and harassed guests and staff over payments.
ASP Deepak Mishra reportedly termed the viral video AI-generated and fake, while an investigation into the incident and the allegations is underway.
